description: #193 ground-truth for Phase-2 grading (job_fit). Turns the drift-only grading eval (eval_grading_prompts, ρ vs shifting production baseline) into a CORRECTNESS one: a fixed set of (target, resume, job) triples where the correct fit is GROSSLY unambiguous. Only extreme cases are labeled (a warehouse job vs a senior-frontend target+resume MUST score low; a matching senior-frontend job MUST score high) with WIDE bands (high>=50, low<=25) — so it catches gross grading regressions without over-specifying a subtle score. targets are keyed and shared across cases. NB: the bands are hand-set and have NOT been ratified against the live grader — run scripts/eval_grading_correctness.py and adjust before treating as a gate.
